aperture.hole_policy: explicit SLVERR on the host AXI path and mem_rsp_error on the engine path; never aliases

aperture.module_ports: args: APERTURE_BASE/BYTES, BANK_A/B/D/C_BASE, BANK_BYTES; page_busy; memory_ready; absolute AXI4-Lite staging slave; engine 16-bit serialized port engine_req_*/engine_rsp_*; busy; irq

command_bo.reason: alternative adopted: the page needs exactly one 16-bit serialized memory master (capture-then-issue + engine both target the aperture), so Image B needs no new page master arbiter in the shared 64 KiB window and ew-int cannot contend with pooling/EW

register_layout.08: STATUS (R) frozen rk_job_control word; authoritative LSB positions: [0] can_submit, [1] active, [2] result_valid, [3] result_error, [4] memory_ready, [5] core_error, [6] core_busy, [10:8] fields_valid, [31:11] zero (corrected from the early-coordination sketch)
register_layout.14: START_AMOUNT (RW) raw command QWORD count, one of {18,31,44}; anything else fails closed
register_layout.20: RESULT_TASKS (R) 1 on success (single terminal task; captured PC tail zero)
register_layout.24: RESULT_CODE (R) 0 success, 1 unknown reg/target, 2 unsupported value/op/dtype, 3 incomplete/framing, 4 invalid address, 5 memory bus error (incl. aperture hole), 6 invalid page command, 7 PC-chain/framing violation, 8 timeout

page_abi.submit_requires: all three fields valid + memory_ready (aperture host staging idle) + engine start_ready; status/bresps from unchanged frozen rk_job_control
page_abi.error_policy: sticky until fabric reset (frozen rk_job_control has no error-ack); engine+decoder reset per job so clean jobs are back-to-back without fabric reset
page_abi.register_access: ro-register writes SLVERR; unmapped page offset SLVERR
page_abi.raw_stream: page fetches exactly START_AMOUNT QWORDs little-endian (low halfword first) from the aperture into a 44-entry capture, drives them unchanged into the integer decoder (no field rewrite/CPU fixup), enforces the frozen four-QWORD tail framing, runs the integer engine on the aperture, never writes the command BO
page_abi.page_ports: clk,rst_n; memory_ready; page_cancel; 16-bit-offset AXI4-Lite slave; 16-bit serialized memory master mem_req_*/mem_rsp_*; page_busy/page_done/page_error/page_error_code/irq

wiring.page_busy: page page_busy gates aperture host access (host access while page busy => SLVERR)
wiring.memory_ready: aperture host staging idle raises memory_ready to the page's job_control
wiring.engine_master: aperture owns the page's single 16-bit serialized engine master; no shared-window arbiter
wiring.no_impact: no gating/arbitration changes to EW or pooling
wiring.top: ypcb_image_b_top: page bus [3] -> rk_ew_int_page_axi (16-bit offsets); page bus [4] -> rk_ew_int_aperture (absolute addresses); page mem_* <-> aperture engine_*; aperture memory_ready -> page; page page_busy -> aperture + any_engine_busy; page_cancel=0.
